name: the rule: the end of the game
note: The game ends by a mate, a stalemate, the material criterion, the fifty-move clock or the third occurrence: Lean proves a position the spec ends is one the kernel's Chess.gameStatus ends but possibly for the criterion's knight clause (Ideas.LegalEquiv.terminal_sound), and a position Chess.gameStatus ends is one the spec ends or a FIDE dead position beyond the criterion (terminal_complete) -- the two terminals are not equal, that is the obstacle, so a CONJECTURE; in the Rust core game.rs `terminal`, certified by the oracle test.
